notes.title: Update - 3 new languages - Spanish, Italian, French!
notes.content:
¡Hola! Ciao! Salut! 

We are back with an update! Now you can dive and explore the amazing world of Reef Shot with new language options: subtitles and interface are available in Spanish, Italian and French, on top of English and German that were already there.

Check out the new language options and let us know what you think!

All the best,
Nano Games Team

notes.title: Reef Shot is finally here!
notes.content:
Dear Community,

We're very happy and excited! Reef Shot is now available on Steam. 
We're looking forward to your feedback and hope you will have a good time diving! 

Have fun!
